samples.summary: Line reference for applyInlineStyle points at the mergeInlineStyle doc-comment, not the function itself
samples.evidence: todo.md says 'hands the `false` straight through Doc.applyInlineStyle → store.applyStyle → applyInlineStyle (`packages/docs/src/store/block-helpers.ts:310`), which merges it into the run style verbatim.' Line 310 in block-helpers.ts is inside the docblock for the private `mergeInlineStyle` helper (lines 306-315); the `applyInlineStyle` function itself starts at line 331. The description of the bug ('merges it into the run style verbatim') also describes the pre-fix behavior, while the code at that location now shows the already-fixed merge (dropping undefined keys) — a minor imprecision for a reader trying to jump to the described behavior.
